subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose global cron restart catch-up controls, add a per-job missed-run policy, or keep missed-job catch-up behavior internal for now?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but this adds a compatibility-sensitive public `openclaw.json` scheduler surface and affects duplicate delivery versus missed scheduled work.

options.title: Expose bounded global controls
options.body: Add validated global cron settings for max immediate missed jobs and stagger delay while preserving current defaults.

options.title: Design per-job missed-run policy
options.body: Add an explicit job-level policy so announcement jobs can skip catch-up while monitoring jobs can still replay.

options.title: Keep internal only
options.body: Leave current catch-up defaults unchanged and handle specific duplicate-delivery bugs with narrower scheduler logic.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded global controls
recommendation.body: Add validated global cron settings for max immediate missed jobs and stagger delay while preserving current defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original internal restart-stagger work and are a reasonable routing candidate for the public config-surface decision.
